newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Vontobel launches venture capital company.
newsitem.headline: Vontobel launches venture capital company.

text.p: Switzerland's Vontobel banking group said it was offering institutional and private investors shares in a new venture capital company it had created. It will seek a bourse listing for it after a two-year start-up period.

Investors can subscribe shares in Private Equity Holding AG until April 25, Vontobel said in a statement. The company will invest via venture capital funds led by managers with solid records of performance.

It said the company assigned the highest priority to diversifying risk. It will invest in different sectors, in diversified markets with the focus on the Alpine region of Europe, and in companies with different stages of development.
